scenarios.description: Tests Stale Section Switch. Memory mentions 'menta' (vape), user asks for 'bandejas' (herbal).
validation_hints: Search query should focus on 'bandejas' or 'rolling trays'
Should NOT include 'menta' or vape keywords in search arguments
Analyst should acknowledge the herbal context if relevant

scenarios.description: Tests Multi-Interest Conflict. Memory has multiple interests, user asks for a different brand.
scenarios.user_message: Quiero algo de la marca Waka.
validation_hints: Should NOT be weighted by 'menta', 'fresa', or 'lost mary' from memory if dominance rule works

scenarios.description: Tests Policy Isolation. Memory has preferences, user asks about store policy.
validation_hints: Memory (uva) should NOT bleed into the response
Tool call should target returns/policy retrieval

scenarios.description: Tests Generic Ambiguity. Vague request, memory holds 'uva'.
validation_hints: Analyst may use 'uva' as a tiebreaker/bias for recommendation
